name: dev-toolkits
description: Personal Claude Code toolkits for specification work and deliberate technical practice.

plugins.name: spec-toolkit
plugins.description: Tools for authoring and evaluating project design/architecture specs against a peer-established rubric.

plugins.name: learning
plugins.description: Turns Claude Code into an interactive coding teacher for deliberate practice. Two session modes over a shared teaching core, with a global spaced-repetition log.

plugins.name: cost-estimate
plugins.description: Prints an estimated dollar cost after every Claude Code turn (and subagent), from a fixed per-model pricing table and the transcript's token usage.

plugins.name: model-picker
plugins.description: Recommends an appropriate Claude or GPT model and effort level for an upcoming task.
